name: solvent-buffer-cryoprotectant-list
description: Draft list of chemical component dictionary (CCD) IDs that the mmCIF parser drops as water, solvents, buffers, cryoprotectants or crystallization salts. This is a science decision, not an engineering one: researchers must confirm it. Citrate (CIT), sulfate (SO4), phosphate (PO4) and halide ions are often real ligands. See docs/cif-extraction.md.
